in.prompt: Run bin/tts-typecast.sh to synthesize a short Korean welcome audio that says exactly "{{submitter}}님 환영합니다", and write the resulting audio to $OUT/welcome.wav.

run:
set -e
f=$IN/welcome.wav
t=${ENODE_PI_TARGET:-sunny@sunnypi.local}
d=/tmp/enode-demo-$$.wav
scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$f" "$t:$d"
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$t" "amixer -c 1 sset PCM 100% unmute >/dev/null 2>&1; aplay -q -D plughw:1,0 '$d'; rc=\$?; rm -f '$d'; echo played rc=\$rc; exit \$rc"
echo ok > $OUT/played.txt
